lines.say: a synthetic GRF that signals the pituitary to release growth hormone
IGF-1 rises, far above normal in about a third at 26 weeks
visceral (deep belly) fat fell about 15% over 26 weeks versus placebo in adults with HIV
the fat came back in people who stopped
liver fat fell over 12 months in 61 adults with HIV and fatty liver
triglycerides fell and the cholesterol ratio improved in adults with HIV
can rise; 5% vs 1% reached a diabetes-range HbA1c at 26 weeks
injection-site redness, itching or pain (17% vs 6% on placebo)
swelling, joint pain, tingling, sometimes carpal tunnel
allergic reactions such as itching, flushing, hives or rash (4% in trials)
more deaths reported with growth hormone drugs in acute critical illness

ask: How will we track my blood sugar and IGF-1, and at what point would we stop?
